Implementation of power projects
*101. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether of the 44 power projects
under implementation currently, 39
projects are slated to come up by the first
year of the Eleventh Five Year Plan period;
(b) if so, whether 5 projects are reported
to be facing constraints in timely
commissioning;
(c) the total projects that are being
completed within the stipulated period of
time and how many will be there which
will not be completed;
(d) whether any guidelines had been
issued by the Ministry of Statistics and
Programme Implementation to the
Ministry of Power in this regard; and
(e) if so, what steps are being taken by
the Ministry of Power to implement
suggestions made by the Ministry of
Statistics and Programme Implementation?
Non-utilisation of funds under SGSY
*102. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have failed to
spend funds allocated to Sampoorna
Gramin Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY);
(b) if so, whether Centre allocated
Rs. 1000 crore for the programme upto
June this year which was twice the sum
allocated  last year, but only Rs. 469.56
crore of this was released and even paltry
Rs. 61.94 crore was used;
(c) what are the main reasons for failure
in utilisation of funds under SGSY and the
agencies responsible for this;
(d) what action has been taken against
the said agencies; and
(e) what are the steps taken to fully
utilize the funds allocated for SGSY during
the remaining period of 2005-06?

Andhra Pradesh

MENT be pleased to state:

voluntary organizations under the scheme;

the Minister of COMMERCE AND

and

flexibility on opening of services based on

the WTO?

hike in the Capital

state:

campaign against power hike in the Capital

recent increase in power tariff;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government

reconsideration of hike was given to the
State Government; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

the country
†*106. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER

SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that imports in
the country are increasing more than

Organisation

BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Military
Engineering Service has been treated as an
Inter Service Organisation by including the
same as such in the Annual Report of
Ministry of Defence;

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that export of
vegetable oils has been made free and export
restrictions on groundnut oil has been
removed;

vegetable oils exported during 2004-05; and
(c)  their impact on the production of
vegetable oils and their prices in domestic
markets?

victims of Andaman

THIRUNAVUKKARASAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the criteria, cost and plinth
area entitlement fixed by Government for
providing permanent shelters constructed

victims of Andaman district; and
(b) who would be the implementing
Agency for allotment of permanent shelters
to the Tsunami victims of Andaman
district?

PILANIA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the crimes committed against minors
(children), as per the National Crime
Records Bureau, during the last three years,
State-wise and sex-wise;
(b) the rape cases against minor girls,
State-wise;

(c) the disposal of above crimes, namely
challan, conviction etc. and percentages
thereof;
(d) the incidence of crime, per 10 lac of
population, State-wise;
(e) the first three States in the country
having worst scenario of 'crimes against
minors' on the basis of (i) total incidence of
crime (ii) total rapes (iii) total incidence
per 10 lac; and
(f) the steps being taken to protect the
minors?
People to be benefited under NREG
Scheme
†*112. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government of India have
started the implementation of National
Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme and

would be benefited every year and the
amount required for the same;

assets and basic infrastructure works is

and cost of materials; and
(c) the details regarding the system of
implementing, monitoring and controlling
the said programme?

UK representatives the Commerce and

effective tool to promote India-UK
partnership;
(c) whether UK is the second largest
investor in India, and has a bilateral trade
worth 5 billion dollar per annum and
attracts 60% of all Indian investment into
Europe; and
(d) if so, to what extent both India and
U.K. have taken steps to improve further
trade between the two countries?

*114. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India  and Sri
Lanka have begun co-ordinated patrolling
along the international Maritime border;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are also
considering to make a joint patrolling with
the Sri Lankan Navy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
